message.content: {"verdict": "conflict", "citations": ["rbi-12898"], "evidence": [{"doc_id": "rbi-12898", "quote": "It shall be ensured that for digital payment transactions, other than card present transactions, at least one of the factors of authentication is dynamically created or proven, i.e., the proof of possession of the factor, being sent as part of the transaction, is unique to that transaction."}], "confidence": 1.0, "rationale": "The policy permits a static password as one of the two factors for card-not-present transactions, whereas RBI directions mandate that at least one factor for such transactions must be dynamically created or proven and unique to the transaction."}
